notes: Safe areas are fractions of the frame kept CLEAR of text, logos and key action: top, bottom, left, right.
They are review guides only. qa-reel.mjs draws them on a separate contact sheet; they are never part of a composition or the final MP4.
Organic Reels: Meta publishes no fixed margins. The organic guide follows the kit's short-form phone-safe region (x 90-930, y 200-1600 at 1080x1920) and is approximate.
Ads: Meta's Reels ad guidance as widely cited in 2026 (14% top, 35% bottom, 6% sides; 40% bottom with a disclaimer). Verify against Meta's current Ads Guide before publishing.

organic.label: Organic Reel, 30 fps
organic.audio: aac when the reel has sound

organic-60.label: Organic Reel, 60 fps (fast motion, screen recordings, sport)

ad-disclaimer.label: Reels advertisement with an on-screen disclaimer
